about.text: Laban is a general name for sour fermented milk, meaning buttermilk in the Arabian Peninsula and yoghurt in the Levant and Iraq. Buttermilk-style laban is milk left to ferment for about 24 hours and churned to remove the butter; the yoghurt style is boiled milk set with yoghurt or leftover laban overnight.
